title: Performance of 18 F-DCFPyL PET/CT in Primary Prostate Cancer Diagnosis, Gleason Grading and D'Amico Classification: A Radiomics-Based Study.
summary: A three-layer ensemble of PET/CT radiomic features was evaluated against pathology in 138 treatment-naive patients and reported specific malignancy and risk-classification results; evidence is retrospective, monocentric and internally resampled only. AI role: PET/CT radiomics ensemble for pathology-referenced classification. The article appeared in Phenomics (Cham, Switzerland).
